Stepping inside the Monument to Victor Emmanuel II feels like stepping into a piece of Italy’s history. 🇮🇹 The grand white marble columns, intricate details and monumental architecture make this one of Rome’s most impressive landmarks.

Built in honour of Victor Emmanuel II, the first king of unified Italy, the monument stands proudly in the heart of Rome and represents the unity and identity of the country. From its sweeping staircases to the incredible views across the city, it’s a place that feels just as powerful as it looks.

Exploring the most alien place on Earth 👽🌎

Socotra, Yemen parece sacada de otro planeta, pero está en la Tierra, aislada durante millones de años, esta isla tiene una biodiversidad única: más del 30% de sus especies no existen en ningún otro lugar del mundo 🪾

Algunas de sus especies llevan evolucionando aquí durante millones de años, haciendo que sea uno de los lugares más únicos del planeta 🙏

The closer you look, the more the ocean reveals.

While photographing this barrel jellyfish, I became completely absorbed in the small details: the textures, the blue edges, the transparent layers and all those shapes we would normally swim past without really noticing.

And yes, getting that close came with a few light stings, but it was completely worth it.

Going through the files afterwards was probably one of my favourite parts. Being able to zoom in and discover things I didn’t even see while I was underwater is one of the reasons I love photography so much.

Rhizostoma pulmo — Barrel jellyfish

Two weeks ago I found out there would be a total eclipse in Spain and I made sure to get all the gear I needed to turn this into a core memory.

I don’t know if I’ll ever have another opportunity to shoot something like this in my life so I put every chance on my side.

This would have been impossible without @dylan.marzoli, @ornella.addeo and @anitastuberg. 

Dylan directed the girls via walkie-talkie since we were around 200m away from them. We had to keep moving up the hill every couple of minutes to keep the sun in frame.

One of the most rewarding shoots of my life and somehow it felt like it happened in seconds. If you ever get the chance to capture a total eclipse in your life, do it.

Living in Exmouth, Western Australia, I encounter tiger sharks regularly while photographing the waters of Ningaloo Reef. For years, I had hoped to capture an image of a tiger shark approaching me out of curiosity, but without using bait such encounters are uncommon in an ecosystem where food is abundant.
On the day this photograph was made, I was swimming at the surface while following a tiger shark several metres below. After a few minutes of photographing the animal from above, it suddenly turned and swam directly toward me. Focused on composing the image, I continued shooting as it closed the distance.
Moments later, the shark briefly took the dome port of my camera into its mouth before immediately releasing it and disappearing into the blue. So focused on making the photographs, I barely registered what had happened. Only when reviewing the images later did I see how the encounter had unfolded. Having followed the shark closely for several minutes, I may have prompted its response; the brief contact appeared exploratory rather than aggressive, as the shark investigated an unfamiliar object in its environment.

Это все еще Китай. Просто тот, который мы почти никогда не видим 🇨🇳

На самом юге провинции Юньнань находится Хунхэ - регион, о котором до этой поездки я ничего не знал 🤔

И именно здесь находятся те самые рисовые террасы народа хани. Они спускаются по горам на километры, вокруг стоят традиционные деревни с домами, похожими на грибы, а многие вещи, которые сегодня кажутся туристическим опытом, для местных остаются частью обычной жизни 🌾

Наверное, поэтому это место так сильно отличается от привычных красивых локаций. Здесь хочется не просто приехать, снять кадр и уехать, а реально посмотреть, как все устроено 👀 

📍 Что сохранить для поездки в Хунхэ:

🌾 Yuanyang Hani Rice Terraces - те самые огромные рисовые террасы
🏘 Azheke Village - традиционная деревня народа хани среди террас
🎣 попробовать местную рыбалку прямо среди рисовых полей
🧶 познакомиться с традиционным прядением и ремеслами хани
🏠 увидеть знаменитые «грибные» дома
🪷 водная прогулка среди тысяч лотосов
🍜 Mengzi - попробовать лапшу «через мост» на ее родине
🚂 Bisezhai Railway Station - историческая станция старой Юньнань–Вьетнамской железной дороги

Еще одно напоминание, насколько огромным и разным может быть Китай 🙃
